changelog: 🍽️ Dinner Check-in Shelf: Review pending scheduled meals at the top of Weekly Planner, confirm whether meals were actually made, or dismiss/skip
🧒 Kid Dinner Ratings & Clean-Plate Tracking: Track per-kid eating feedback (Ate it / Passed) for every cooked dinner with historical eating percentages
🪄 AI Recipe Refiner: Modify recipe ingredients, cooking times, steps, and chef notes automatically using Gemini AI based on post-dinner feedback notes
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family & Kids Setup: Configurable kid and family member profiles added to both the 5-Step Guided Onboarding Wizard and Settings & Accounts
📊 Kid Preferences Leaderboard: View each kid's overall clean-plate rate, top rated favorites, and disliked meals in Settings
🛑 Decoupled Cooking History: Prevents premature incrementing of 'times_made' upon cart staging or calendar push; only updates when confirmed cooked
🍳 Quick Log Cook: Ad-hoc cooking log and kid rating capture directly on recipe cards in the Recipe Database without needing a prior schedule
⭐ Kid-Approved Filtering & Badges: Filter Recipe Database by kid approval rates (≥70% or per-kid ≥50%) and view live kid rating badges on recipe cards
